effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.hinder.descr: Your attacks inflict Slowness II for five seconds.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.projectile_d: Cancels projectile hits and attempts to teleport you a short distance away. Each dodge consumes ten seconds of effect duration.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.instant_smel: Automatically smelts some drops from mined ore blocks. Higher levels smelt more items per block.
effect.kaleidoscope_cookery.vitality.des: Killing an adult animal spawns a baby of the same type. Adult zombies spawn a baby zombie, with a small chance to spawn a baby villager instead.
advancements.kaleidoscope_cookery.nitrog: Ascend 1900 blocks using the effect of flatulence.
